facility.name: Greater Love Learning Academy LLC
facility.programs_provided: After School Care,Skill Classes,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips,Night Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 3400 OLD FM 440 RD, KILLEEN, TX, 76549

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: During a DFPS investigation, it was found a caregiver was telling children in care  to "shut up."
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: During a DFPS investigation, it was found infants were observed in swings with propped bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During a DFPS investigation it was found a caregiver was heard yelling and  screaming at infants in care. Another caregiver was found to be yelling at children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check: During a DFPS investigation it was found the operation allowed an individual to  be present at the operation without a background check and having access to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check (26 TAC §745.621(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: During a DFPS investigation a caregiver was observed grabbing and pulling  children by their arms. The caregiver was observed grab/yank a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Meal and Snack Service - Not Hurried: During a DFPS investigation it was found a caregiver took food away from a child  before allowing the child to finish eating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Meal and Snack Service - Not Hurried (26 TAC §746.3319(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During a DFPS investigation it was found a caregiver was observed leaving the  classroom, with children in care, unattended on multiple occasions for several minutes, no  other caregiver being present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs: During a DFPS investigation it was found a caregiver did not have a written  activity plan to follow with a balance of activities to promote growth and development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs (26 TAC §746.2201)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: During a DFPS investigation it was found a four-year-old child in care was placed  in a high-chair for over an hour.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During a DFPS investigation it was found a caregiver held a child down on the  floor so the child could not move.  During a DFPS investigation it was found an operation staff member was yelling at staff in  front of the children in care.  During a DFPS investigation it was found a caregiver was throwing blocks at a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing mat was observed with a hole in it and was not sanitized by the caregiver after being used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: The children did not wash their hands after being assisted to the toilet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Assisting a Child with Toileting: The caregiver did not wash their hands after assisting the children with toileting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Assisting a Child with Toileting (26 TAC §746.3415(5))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: Caregivers were not supporting the children in a positive way. The caregivers displayed frustration with some of the behaviors the children were demonstrating and were observed and heard reacting negatively with the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Caregivers were observed moving children around and handling them in a frustrating-aggressive manner. A caregiver was also heard yelling and humiliating a child while the inspector was in the operation conducting an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Caregivers did not have current CPR and First Aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings: A broken bicycle was observed on the playground where a group of children were playing, posing a risk of injury to the children. This was corrected during the inspection when the bicycle was removed from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Screentime activities were observed in a classroom of children under two years of age. This was corrected during the inspection, when the caregiver turn the screen off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: 4 of the required 8 drills had been completed. 4 severe weather/shelter in place drills and 4 lock down drills must be completed annually for a total of 8 drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Components of the written operational policies were missing from the parent handbook. Parent's rights, emergency preparedness plan, suspension.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Toys and Equipment to be Sanitized Set Aside: During the inspection, numerous toys and equipment was observed torn, tattered and broken. The items cause pinching and other hazards that pose risk to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Toys and Equipment to be Sanitized Set Aside (26 TAC §746.3407(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the inspection two ceilings fans located in classrooms used by children in care were found to be covered in dust. This was corrected at inspection when the fans were cleaned.     During the inspection a caregiver's purse was observed to be on a shelf in an area where children were playing. This was corrected at inspection when the purse was removed and stored in an area that is out of reach of the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: A caregiver, responsible for a group of children in care, was found to be asleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation: An operation staff member stated they place children in time out for 5-10 minutes, which exceeds the required minute per age for their age group.     This was corrected at inspection when appropriate time frames were discussed with the staff member.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(D))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: A transportation vehicle purchased less than 3 years ago was found to not have an electronic child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: Playground equipment at the operation was found to have two slides that do not have the required six feet use zone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The first aid kits reviewed in the transportation vehicle was found to have an ice pack that exploded inside, some items were missing, and had expired medication.     This was corrected at inspection when a new first aid kit was placed in each transportation vehicle which has all required items in them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: During the inspection two separate classrooms were observed to not wash the children's hands after changing their diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Children's potty chairs were in a classroom with waste inside of them. This was corrected at inspection when the potty chairs were removed from the classroom.     Cleaning chemicals were observed on a bookcase within reach of the children in care. This was corrected at inspection when the items were removed and stored out of reach of the children in care.     Garbage cans in two classrooms were found to have no lids and dirty diapers were on top within reach.     The fence surrounding the playground areas were found to be rolling up and presenting an entrapment hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: The nap room was made up of mixed ages, specified age group for the room was 22 making the room out of ratio by 11.     The infant room was found to have 10 children in care with one caregiver, making the room out of ratio by 6. This was corrected at inspection when an additional caregiver came into the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 3 of 7 children's files reviewed were found to not have an admission date.     2 of 7 children's files reviewed were found to not have the field trip admission information completed.     2 of 7 children's files reviewed were found to not have water activity permission completed.    2 of 7 children's files reviewed were found to not have health care information completed.     2 of 7 children's files reviewed were found to not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Activity plans observed in the operation's classrooms did not include outside time for any of the age groups and were not detailed as to the activities the children engage in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: A fire extinguisher found in a transportation vehicle was found to have the needle on the undercharged section. This was corrected at inspection when a new fire extinguisher was placed in the transportation vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

nearby.name: The Nurturing Nest Child Development Center
